headline: Linn Mercy Warden Hold Erased; Weathered Expanse Toll Heaviest
war_summary: Linn Mercy's last Warden work has been struck from the ledger since the noon edition, leaving eight Colonial posts and three unclaimed strongpoints where a full ten stood held only hours before. The fighting there remains the sharpest on the map: four actions in two hours and twenty-four across the day, two-hour casualties past three thousand on both sides combined, and the latest clashes logged at Outwich Ranch and Lathair as this dispatch went to press. Weathered Expanse carries the heaviest butcher's bill of the war, roughly eleven thousand Colonial and thirteen thousand Warden casualties in a day, its nine works now divided four Colonial, three Warden and two unclaimed after fifteen events in six hours. Palantine Berm, busiest sector of the day at fifty-three events, stands four Warden posts to three Colonial, with Vendett and Windburn Landing the points of contention. Marban Hollow's Checkpoint Bua and Nevish Line's Grief Mother remain lively though reduced, while Stonecradle reports a single unclaimed work. Thirty-four towns are still required for victory.
